findings.explanation: “Descending into a free-for-all” treats the source-specific descent verb as part of the fixed idiom. The reusable noun idiom is “a free-for-all”; descending into is one natural frame but is substitutable.
findings.recommendedFix: Teach a free-for-all as the target and retain descending into as an example frame; ensure target pattern covers the source and future natural frames.
